title: SB6169 (2023-2024 Regular): Increasing the potential pool of law enforcement hires by allowing active and retired law enforcement and military personnel to import certain firearms for personal use.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/biennium/2023-24/Htm/Bills/Senate%20Bills/6169.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version (2024 Regular Session despite the 2023 id). Subsection (1) and (4) are existing law reprinted; the change is new (2)(f), with 'or' struck from the end of (2)(d). Sec. 2 is an emergency clause.

operative_text:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.390): (1) No person in this state may manufacture, import, distribute, sell, or offer for sale any assault weapon, except as authorized in this section.
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.390): (2)(f) Active and retired law enforcement officers, active duty military personnel, honorably discharged veterans, and federal employees who receive a change of station order or are directed to move to Washington state by their respective federal agency, solely for the purpose of importing and retaining for personal use, assault weapons owned prior to receiving orders directing a change of station or move to Washington state.
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.390): (4) A person who violates this section is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.
